title: 第1章 半个天才第2章 蝴蝶效应
content_zh:
第一章 半个天才
“这究竟是怎么回事？”，高洪再次睁开双眼后，却惊讶地发现自己竟然身在公安局，而更加令他感到不可思议的是，明明已经年近五旬的自己竟然变成了一个小孩，瞧那小胳膊小腿，估计也就十来岁......
虽然生于六七十年代之交，但作为国内少壮派教练的第一人，高洪对于“穿越”这个词汇并不陌生，但却从没有想过自己居然也有这样的机会。不一会儿的工夫，高洪就由这具新身体内残留的记忆碎片得知如今才是2000年，而这个小孩出生于贵州的一个小山村，现在才12周岁，两年前与他相依为命的父亲不幸离世，因为代为抚养的叔叔对他不好，这个倔强的孩子愤而出走，却倒霉地碰上了犯罪团队，被其控制来行乞赚钱。前不久公安干警围捕这一犯罪团伙的过程中，某个头目情急之下想拿这个小孩作为人质脱身，结果被特警狙击手击毙，但那个混蛋却没有立即死透，在临死之前鱼死网破地将这个小孩狠狠摔了出去，一头撞上墙角，就此昏迷不醒，到现在已经有好几天了......
高洪的个性一向都很想得开，很快他就付诸一笑，想道，“亲属没良心也不全是坏事，至少以后省得跟那些没有感情基础的所谓‘亲人’来往了。嘿，穿越后记忆可以继承，情感却还是我原先的，难道感情是烙印在灵魂上而非脑子里吗？”
既然不准备与那些“亲人”来往，高洪就决定不再用小孩原来的名字，而由于担心这个时空也有一个“高洪”，他自己的名字显然也不宜用，最后高洪想起了一个新的名字，对公安局里的叔叔阿姨说自己叫“高军”。
这个“军”字其实取自一位在球员时代一度与高洪齐名、也同样是报国无门的锋线天才，与高洪更擅长把握住那些容易得分的机会、并以最合理、也最朴实无华的方式十分稳当地射门得分不同，那位绰号“胡椒”的天才前锋胡军明明踢球的方式极不合理，却总是能用各种令人意想不到的方式将一些不是机会的机会转化为进球，而成为当时中国最好的几个射手之一......
当然，若论实用性，显然还是高洪这种稳定得可怕的射手更好，当年踢球的时候，高洪在大多数场次都是替补出场的情况下，却几乎每一年都能保证进入国内顶级联赛（包括甲A联赛开始以前）射手榜的前三名，并曾拿到过多次金靴，巅峰时期甚至可以做到平均每场1个进球、半个助攻，这样恐怖的高效率在中国足坛可谓是空前绝后，而他的恩师徐根保更是赞扬说，“郝大炮、范将军算什么天才？小高十次射门能够打进七八个，这才叫天才！”
高洪强的不仅仅是射门的精度和门前的冷静，他的跑位和对球路的预判同样是世界级的，但也不知道老天是不是故意要为难中国足球，球商无以伦比的高洪却是一个先天性肺功能不全患者，他的最大吸氧量甚至还不如一个未成年的小姑娘......
这无疑极大地限制了高洪的体能，以致于他每场比赛的跑动距离连守门员都不如，而比赛场上的机会都是跑出来的，你一点都跑不动，每场比赛能够获得的机会也就十分有限了，同时教练也因此更倾向于让他替补上场，而这样一来，比赛时间少了，自然进球机会也就变得更少了。而更要命的是，这一先天性的缺陷还极大地限制了高洪年轻时期的生长发育，使他成为了一个既无力量、又无速度，同时也没体能的“三无”球员，足球毕竟是一项体育运动，没有出色的身体素质（注1）作为基础，技术与意识再好也成不了世界顶级的巨星。
其实中国足球的历史上类似的例子还有很多，某些球员在一两个方面拥有世界一流的水准，但却都在别的某些方面存在着致命的先天缺陷（详见后文），因而上升空间也就相对有限了，说白了还是中国足球人口偏少，筛选余地较小，加之现代足球是诞生于西方的运动，中国人在饮食、文化等各方面不如欧美人更加契合，再加上基层青训教练的素质低下，因而进一步降低了年轻球员的成材率，想要出一个综合能力很强的球员自然远比那些足球强国难得多了，能够出现高洪这种优点缺点都很明显的球员就算是运气不错了......
但这次穿越却令高军萌生了一点希望，特别是公安局顺便帮他做了一次全身体检、发现一切正常之后，想到自己能够以健康的身体踢球，高军就不禁期待不已，“这具身体虽然也有些瘦弱，但比我原来那具先天性肺功能不全的身体肯定强多了，只要达到普通成年男子的水平，球技恢复后至少达到亚洲一流前锋的水准没什么难度，既然老天给了这次机会，就让我先从球员当起，继续为了拯救中国足球而奋斗吧！”
而且高军还很快意识到，这个小孩的年纪正好能够赶上中国足球滑入谷底之前出的最后一批人才、即85国青和88国少，当初他执教国家队时就是以此为骨干，加上其后两批国青国少里的几个零星人才和几个稳定军心的老将，组建出了一支打破“32年不胜韩”魔咒的国家队，虽然最终因为足球以外的因素而功败垂成，但是这批球员的实力还是毋庸置疑的。
注1：速度、力量与体能至少要有一样达到世界一流（不一定要是最顶尖，比如百米速度能够跑进11秒5，加上比较快的启动，比赛中就有不小的优势了。），比如梅西的速度（梅西的绝对速度不算最快的那种，但百米速度也能跑进11秒，而且他的步频之快世上无人能及。）、小贝的体能（一场比赛跑动距离可以达到14000米）、齐祖的力量，而马拉多纳兼有速度和力量，加上无以伦比的技术和球商，就成为了一代球王。而身高或者弹跳厉害自然也是优势，但却需要一定的力量支持，平衡性也是如此，灵活性则需要速度和爆发力来配合，因此价值比不上另外几项属性......

Chapter 1 Half Genius
"What on earth is going on?" After Gao Hong opened his eyes again, he was surprised to find that he was in the Public Security Bureau. What made him even more incredible was that he, who was already in his fifties, had turned into a child. Looking at his little arms and legs, he was probably only ten years old...
Although he was born at the turn of the 1960s and 1970s, as the first young coach in China, Gao Hong is no stranger to the word "travel", but he never thought that he would have such an opportunity. After a while, Gao Hong learned from the memory fragments left in this new body that it was now the year 2000, and that this child was born in a small mountain village in Guizhou and was now only 12 years old. His father, with whom he was dependent, passed away unfortunately two years ago. Because the uncle who raised him on his behalf was not good to him, the stubborn child ran away angrily, but unfortunately he ran into a criminal team and was controlled by them to beg and make money. Not long ago, when the police were rounding up this criminal gang, a certain leader wanted to use the child as a hostage to escape, but was shot dead by a SWAT sniper. However, the bastard did not die immediately. Before he died, he threw the child out, hit his head into a corner, and fell unconscious. It has been several days now...
Gao Hong's personality has always been open-minded, and he soon smiled and thought, "It's not entirely a bad thing if relatives have no conscience. At least I won't have to deal with those so-called 'relatives' who have no emotional basis in the future. Hey, after time travel, the memory can be inherited, but the emotions are still my original ones. Are emotions imprinted on the soul rather than in the brain?"
Since he was not going to interact with those "relatives", Gao Hong decided not to use the child's original name. And because he was worried that there would be a "Gao Hong" in this time and space, his own name was obviously inappropriate. Finally, Gao Hong thought of a new name and told his uncle and aunt in the Public Security Bureau that his name was "Gao Jun."
The word "military" is actually taken from a striker genius who was once as famous as Gao Hong in his playing days and who also had no way to serve the country. Unlike Gao Hong, who was better at seizing those easy scoring opportunities and scoring goals very steadily in the most reasonable and unpretentious way, the talented forward Hu Jun, nicknamed "Pepper", obviously played in an extremely unreasonable way, but he was always able to use various unexpected methods to convert some opportunities that were not opportunities into goals, and became one of the best shooters in China at that time...
Of course, in terms of practicality, it is obviously better to have a terrifyingly stable shooter like Gao Hong. When he was playing football back then, Gao Hong was guaranteed to be among the top three scorers in the top domestic leagues (including before the start of the A-League) almost every year even though he came on as a substitute in most games. He has won multiple Golden Boots, and even averaged 1 goal and half an assist per game at his peak. This terrifying efficiency is unprecedented in Chinese football. His mentor Xu Genbao even praised him, saying, "What kind of geniuses are Hao Dapao and General Fan? Xiao Gao can score seven or eight times in ten shots. This is called a genius!"
Gao Hong is not only strong in shooting accuracy and calmness in front of the goal, but his running position and prediction of the ball path are also world-class. But I don’t know if God is deliberately trying to embarrass Chinese football. Gao Hong, who has unparalleled football intelligence, is a patient with congenital pulmonary insufficiency. His maximum oxygen intake is even lower than that of an underage girl...
This undoubtedly greatly limits Gao Hong's physical fitness, so that his running distance in each game is not as good as that of the goalkeeper, and the opportunities on the field are all run out. You can't run at all, and the opportunities you can get in each game are very limited. At the same time, the coach is more inclined to let him come on as a substitute.However, the chances of scoring goals have become fewer. What's more terrible is that this congenital defect also greatly restricted Gao Hong's growth and development in his youth, making him a "three-no" player with neither strength, speed, nor physical fitness. After all, football is a sport. Without excellent physical fitness (Note 1) as a basis, no matter how good his skills and awareness are, he cannot become a world-class superstar.
In fact, there are many similar examples in the history of Chinese football. Some players have world-class standards in one or two aspects, but they all have fatal congenital defects in other aspects (see below for details), so the room for improvement is relatively limited. To put it bluntly, the Chinese football population is small, and there is less room for selection. In addition, modern football is a sport born in the West. The Chinese are not as compatible as Europeans and Americans in aspects such as food and culture. In addition, the quality of youth training coaches at the grassroots level is low, which further reduces the success rate of young players. It is naturally much more difficult to produce a player with strong comprehensive ability than those from football powers. It is considered lucky to have a player like Gao Hong with obvious advantages and disadvantages...
But this time travel gave Gao Jun some hope, especially after the Public Security Bureau gave him a physical examination and found that everything was normal. Gao Jun couldn't help but look forward to thinking that he could play football in a healthy body. "Although this body is a little thin, it is better than my original one." The body of a person born with pulmonary insufficiency is definitely much stronger. As long as it reaches the level of an ordinary adult man, it is not difficult to at least reach the level of Asia's top forwards after recovering. Since God has given me this opportunity, let me start as a player and continue to fight to save Chinese football!"
Moreover, Gao Jun quickly realized that this child was just old enough to catch up with the last batch of talents before Chinese football fell into the bottom, namely the 85 National Youth League and the 88 National Youth League. He used this as the backbone when he coached the national team, plus the two subsequent batches of National Youth League. A few sporadic talents from the national youth team and a few veterans with stable military morale formed a national team that broke the curse of "not defeating South Korea for 32 years". Although it ultimately failed due to factors other than football, there is no doubt about the strength of this group of players.
Note 1: At least one of the speed, strength and physical fitness must be world-class (not necessarily the top, for example, if you can run 100 meters in 11.5 seconds, plus a relatively fast start, there will be a big advantage in the game.), such as Messi's speed (Messi's absolute speed is not the fastest, but He can also run 100 meters in 11 seconds, and his cadence is unparalleled in the world), Beckham's physical fitness (he can run up to 14,000 meters in a game), and Zizou's strength. Maradona's combination of speed and strength, coupled with unparalleled skills and football intelligence, has become a generation of football kings. Being tall or jumping well is naturally an advantage, but it requires a certain amount of strength support, as does balance. Flexibility requires speed and explosive power, so its value is not as good as other attributes...
